task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to the box stack, pick BOX_TOP first because only the top box is pickable, move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE, return to the stack to pick BOX_MIDDLE, place BOX_MIDDLE on INSPECTION_TABLE, then move BOX_TOP onto BOX_BOTTOM so only the middle box is removed from the original stack.
assumptions: CAR is the only robot and is available for the task.
Only the current top element of the stack can be picked, so BOX_TOP must be removed before BOX_MIDDLE can be picked.
TEMP_TABLE is a valid temporary placement location for BOX_TOP.
After BOX_MIDDLE is removed, placing BOX_TOP onto BOX_BOTTOM is valid and achieves the desired final stack appearance.
Navigating to the exact object-support coordinates with tolerance 0.5 places CAR within its interaction distance of 2.0.
